verses.en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.pt: Tiago, servo de Deus e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, às doze tribos da Dispersão, saúde.
verses.en_web: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
verses.en_bbe: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, sends words of love to the twelve tribes of the Jews living in all parts of the earth.

verses.en: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, tende por motivo de grande gozo o passardes por várias provações,
verses.en_web: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
verses.en_bbe: Let it be all joy to you, my brothers, when you undergo tests of every sort;

verses.en: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.
verses.pt: sabendo que a aprovação da vossa fé produz a perseverança;
verses.en_web: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have the knowledge that the testing of your faith gives you the power of going on in hope;

verses.en: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.pt: e a perseverança tenha a sua obra perfeita, para que sejais perfeitos e completos, não faltando em coisa alguma.
verses.en_web: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
verses.en_bbe: But let this power have its full effect, so that you may be made complete, needing nothing.

verses.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.pt: Ora, se algum de vós tem falta de sabedoria, peça-a a Deus, que a todos dá liberalmente e não censura, e ser-lhe-á dada.
verses.en_web: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
verses.en_bbe: But if any man among you is without wisdom, let him make his request to God, who gives freely to all without an unkind word, and it will be given to him.

verses.en: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.pt: Peça-a, porém, com fé, não duvidando; pois aquele que duvida é semelhante à onda do mar, que é sublevada e agitada pelo vento.
verses.en_web: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
verses.en_bbe: Let him make his request in faith, doubting nothing; for he who has doubt in his heart is like the waves of the sea, which are troubled by the driving of the wind.

verses.en: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.pt: Não pense tal homem que receberá do Senhor alguma coisa,
verses.en_web: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Let it not seem to such a man that he will get anything from the Lord;

verses.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.pt: homem vacilante que é, e inconstante em todos os seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
verses.en_bbe: For there is a division in his mind, and he is uncertain in all his ways.

verses.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.pt: Mas o irmão de condição humilde glorie-se na sua exaltação,
verses.en_web: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
verses.en_bbe: But let the brother of low position be glad that he is lifted up;

verses.en: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.pt: e o rico no seu abatimento; porque ele passará como a flor da erva.
verses.en_web: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
verses.en_bbe: But the man of wealth, that he is made low; because like the flower of the grass he will come to his end.

verses.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.pt: Pois o sol se levanta em seu ardor e faz secar a erva; a sua flor cai e a beleza do seu aspecto perece; assim murchará também o rico em seus caminhos.
verses.en_web: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.
verses.en_bbe: For when the sun comes up with its burning heat, the grass gets dry and the grace of its form is gone with the falling flower; so the man of wealth comes to nothing in his ways.

verses.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que suporta a provação; porque, depois de aprovado, receberá a coroa da vida, que o Senhor prometeu aos que o amam.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
verses.en_bbe: There is a blessing on the man who undergoes testing; because, if he has God's approval, he will be given the crown of life, which the Lord has said he will give to those who have love for him.

verses.en: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.pt: Ninguém, sendo tentado, diga: Sou tentado por Deus; porque Deus não pode ser tentado pelo mal e ele a ninguém tenta.
verses.en_web: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
verses.en_bbe: Let no man say when he is tested, I am tested by God; for it is not possible for God to be tested by evil, and he himself puts no man to such a test:

verses.en: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.pt: Cada um, porém, é tentado, quando atraído e engodado pela sua própria concupiscência;
verses.en_web: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.
verses.en_bbe: But every man is tested when he is turned out of the right way by the attraction of his desire.

verses.en: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.
verses.pt: então a concupiscência, havendo concebido, dá à luz o pecado; e o pecado, sendo consumado, gera a morte.
verses.en_web: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
verses.en_bbe: Then when its time comes, desire gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is of full growth, gives birth to death.

verses.en: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.pt: Não vos enganeis, meus amados irmãos.
verses.en_web: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be turned from the right way, dear brothers.

verses.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.pt: Toda boa dádiva e todo dom perfeito vêm do alto, descendo do Pai das luzes, em quem não há mudança nem sombra de variação.
verses.en_web: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
verses.en_bbe: Every good and true thing is given to us from heaven, coming from the Father of lights, with whom there is no change or any shade made by turning.

verses.en: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.pt: Segundo a sua própria vontade, ele nos gerou pela palavra da verdade, para que fôssemos como que primícias das suas criaturas.
verses.en_web: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
verses.en_bbe: Of his purpose he gave us being, by his true word, so that we might be, in a sense, the first-fruits of all the things which he had made.

verses.en: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.pt: Sabei isto, meus amados irmãos: Todo homem seja pronto para ouvir, tardio para falar e tardio para se irar.
verses.en_web: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge of this, dear brothers. But let every man be quick in hearing, slow in words, slow to get angry;

verses.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
verses.pt: Porque a ira do homem não opera a justiça de Deus.
verses.en_web: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
verses.en_bbe: For the righteousness of God does not come about by the wrath of man.

verses.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.pt: Pelo que, despojando-vos de toda sorte de imundícia e de todo vestígio do mal, recebei com mansidão a palavra em vós implantada, a qual é poderosa para salvar as vossas almas.
verses.en_web: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, putting away all dirty behaviour and the overweight of evil, take into your souls without pride the word which, being planted there, is able to give you salvation.

verses.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.pt: E sede cumpridores da palavra e não somente ouvintes, enganando-vos a vós mesmos.
verses.en_web: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
verses.en_bbe: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers of it, blinding yourselves with false ideas.

verses.en: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.pt: Pois se alguém é ouvinte da palavra e não cumpridor, é semelhante a um homem que contempla no espelho o seu rosto natural;
verses.en_web: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;
verses.en_bbe: Because if any man is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a glass;

verses.en: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.pt: porque se contempla a si mesmo e vai-se, e logo se esquece de como era.
verses.en_web: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
verses.en_bbe: For after looking at himself he goes away, and in a short time he has no memory of what he was like.

verses.en: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.pt: Entretanto aquele que atenta bem para a lei perfeita, a da liberdade, e nela persevera, não sendo ouvinte esquecido, mas executor da obra, este será bem-aventurado no que fizer.
verses.en_web: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
verses.en_bbe: But he who goes on looking into the true law which makes him free, being not a hearer without memory but a doer putting it into effect, this man will have a blessing on his acts.

verses.en: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
verses.pt: Se alguém cuida ser religioso e não refreia a sua língua, mas engana o seu coração, a sua religião é vã.
verses.en_web: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
verses.en_bbe: If a man seems to have religion and has no control over his tongue but lets himself be tricked by what is false, this man's religion is of no value.

verses.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.pt: A religião pura e imaculada diante de nosso Deus e Pai é esta: Visitar os órfãos e as viúvas nas suas aflições e guardar-se isento da corrupção do mundo.
verses.en_web: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
verses.en_bbe: The religion which is holy and free from evil in the eyes of our God and Father is this: to take care of children who have no fathers and of widows who are in trouble, and to keep oneself untouched by the world.
